name: hydria-arena
description: Hydria Arena V1 - multi-LLM arena with OpenRouter and a local student model.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @hydria-arena/server" "npm run dev -w @hydria-arena/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hydria-arena/server && npm run build -w @hydria-arena/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @hydria-arena/server && npm run build -w @hydria-arena/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hydria-arena/server && npm run test -w @hydria-arena/web
